items.title: A functorial injection from extension by zero into the direct image for a separated etale morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a functorial injective map j_!F -> j_*F for a separated etale morphism j : U -> X, on abelian sheaves and on sheaves of modules (statement lines 11516-11521). The proof constructs the map from the colimit description of extension by zero (proof lines 11523-11549) and then proves injectivity by writing an element as a finite sum of sections with supports in the images of etale maps and separating those supports using separatedness of j (proof lines 11552-11568). The non-formal content is exactly the separation argument. The claim is H2: one construction plus one injectivity argument, both written out.
